results.title: Zverev Reaches US Open 4th Round with Win over Tabilo
results.description: Top seed Alexander Zverev lost his way in the second set but got his game back under control to secure a 6-2 7-6(2) 6-2 victory over Alejandro Tabilo and reach the fourth round of the US Open on Saturday. After spending a grueling nine hours and 26 minutes on court across back-to-back five-setters against Lorenzo Sonego and Quentin Halys, the last thing the German would have wanted was another long night on Arthur Ashe Stadium.

results.title: Lionel Messi, Casemiro Involved In Heated Brawl After Inter Miami's Late 2-2 Draw With Atlanta United | VIDEO
results.description: Lionel Messi and Casemiro were part of a massive brawl post match after Inter Miami settled for a 2-2 draw against Atlanta United. Breel Embolo struck an 87th minute equaliser which sparked tensions after the post match whistle, with Atlanta keeper Lucas Hoyos seen separating the quarelling players.
